title: Natural reversal as a correction of the one remembered fact it reverses (MEM-AR-01B)
purpose: Whether «غيرت رأيي» / «بقيت» / «مبقتش» / «بطلت» supersede exactly the remembered fact they reverse through the existing v1 CORRECT; whether a new preference leaves another preference alone; whether a statement without a cue changes nothing; whether two candidates are asked about; and the recorded limit «بطلت التدخين» beside «بشرب سجاير», which the deterministic grammar cannot relate.
sameTextsAs: WP0 §6 C2 (2026-10-10), narrowed by the approved Task Contract §2.2 (single-valued frames only)

steps.text: افتكر إني بشرب قهوة كل يوم
غيرت رأيي، بقيت ساكن في طنطا
steps.note: «غيرت رأيي» + «بقيت», one remembered residence: expected CORRECT
bare negation of the same object
«بطلت أشرب» against the remembered habit «بشرب قهوة»
a new preference: multi-valued, nothing is superseded
no cue beside «أنا بحب الفول»: nothing is superseded

steps.text: غيرت رأيي، مبقتش بحب الفول، أنا بحب الطعمية

steps.note: no lexical link to «بشرب سجاير»: recorded limit, never inferred
the same reversal again: nothing left to reverse

steps.text: غيرت رأيي وبقيت ساكن في المعادي
steps.note: two remembered residences: expected the existing clarification
the first option offered (the most recent)
